nodes.text: Coppin told me about the tin. ... Twenty years I've kept their count in my head. Head's a poor stone. I want the names cut where the seal stood. Will you carry the asking? My leg won't make the stair twice.
Petra. Mason's yard, up on the crafting terrace. She broke the seal. ... She'll want to do this. And a flame from Sella, at the shrine. That's all of it.
Tell Petra it's Skarn asking. She'll know the length of the list.
... Aye. The stone's not going anywhere. Nor are they.
